title: NoemaForge Release Manifest
description: Top-level, verifiable release contract: identifies the release, the contract epoch it ships, and the signed set of artifacts. A release is GO only after `noema release verify` (0.33.0) succeeds against this manifest.

version.description: Release version (matches the version source of truth, e.g. 0.32.2).

contract_epoch.description: Contract epoch this release ships and pins.

artifacts.description: Every shipped artifact with its content hash.

provenance.description: Build/source provenance (e.g. source ref, builder, SBOM ref).

signature.description: Detached signature over the canonicalized manifest, verified by `noema release verify`.
